'''Nachos''' are a dish of tortilla chips served hot with cheese and various toppings.

==Ingredients==
* 12 [[Cookbook:Ounce|ounces]] (~350 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]]) [[Cookbook:Tortilla Chip|tortilla chips]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Pound|pound]] (450 g) [[Cookbook:Cheddar Cheese|cheddar cheese]], [[Cookbook:Grating|grated]]
* ⅓ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]] canned peeled green [[Cookbook:Chiles|chiles]] (optional)
* ½ cup chopped [[Cookbook:Onion|onion]] (optional)

==Procedure==
# Preheat the [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] to 400°F (200°C). Lay the tortilla chips on a [[Cookbook:Baking Sheet|cookie sheet]].
# [[Cookbook:Mixing#Tossing|Toss]] together the cheese, chilies, and onion, and sprinkle over the tortilla chips.
# [[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] for about 2 minutes until the cheese has melted.
# Serve hot.
